author: dan131riley
body:
#### PR description:

The convertToRaw command uses RawStreamFileWriterForBU to write the output, which by default does not write a RAW_ data file header (it defaults to frdFileVersion = 0).  Files converted this way cannot be read by FedRawDataInputSource. This PR adds an option to set the RawStreamFileWriterForBU frdFileVersion in convertToRaw.

#### PR validation:

Verified that files converted using the new option to set the header version can be read by FedRawDataInputSource.  Default behaviors have not been changed, so this should not affect existing uses for convertToRaw.
title: Add frdFileVersion header version support to convertToRaw
